sys_script_include.description: Counts distinct ACTIVE users holding any x_gegis_ins_policy.* role (a user with several of our roles counts once - seat-based licensing, not role-based) and compares it against x_gegis_ins_policy_licence.licensed_user_count. Sends a daily usage report, and a separate overage alert the moment the count exceeds the licensed seats, to x_gegis_ins_policy.licence_notify_email. Run daily by the "Policy Suite - Daily Licence Usage Report" scheduled job.
sys_script_include.name: LicenceUsageService
